observation.command:
cd /tmp && rm -f c.txt kc2.html after2.html app2.html
# Step 1: first /app/ hit WITH cookie jar (captures code_verifier + session from oauth2-proxy)
AUTH=$(curl -s -b c.txt -c c.txt -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' http://localhost:3000/app/)
echo "captured cookies:"; grep -vE '^\#' c.txt | awk '{print $6}'
echo "auth: ${AUTH:0:90}..."
# Step 2: Keycloak auth page
curl -s -b c.txt -c c.txt -o kc2.html "$AUTH"
ACTION=$(sed -n '/<form/,/<\/form>/p' kc2.html | grep -oE 'action="[^"]+"' | head -1 | sed 's/action="//;s/"//' | sed 's/&/\&/g')
# Step 3: login
curl -s -b c.txt -c c.txt -o after2.html -w 'login: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n' \
  --data-urlencode "credentialId=" \
  --data-urlencode "username=spark@example.com" \
  --data-urlencode "password=SparkLocalPassw0rd!" \
  --data-urlencode "login=Sign In" "$ACTION"
